task: I want to purchase an open-box Samsung Galaxy S25 Plus in excellent condition and trade in a gray Galaxy S20 5G (Verizon), with a perfect screen, in good condition. How much would it cost?
agent_final_answer:
This purchase-with-trade-in cannot be completed as specified, because the Galaxy S20 5G is NOT an eligible trade-in device at Best Buy.

Details:
- The open-box Samsung Galaxy S25+ 256GB (Unlocked) - Navy in EXCELLENT condition is priced at $699.99 (regularly $999.99 new; "Geek Squad Verified - works and looks like new").
- For the trade-in, I checked both Best Buy trade-in tools: (1) the "Check your trade-in value" estimator on the S25+ product page, and (2) the standalone Best Buy Trade-In tool (bestbuy.com/trade-in). In both, after selecting brand = Samsung and using Guided Search, the Model Family list jumps from "Galaxy A56" directly to "Galaxy S21 5G". There is NO Galaxy S20 (or S20 5G) option - the oldest Samsung Galaxy S model accepted for trade-in is the S21.
- Because the Galaxy S20 5G is not in Best Buy's trade-in catalog, no trade-in value (for the gray, Verizon, perfect-screen, good-condition device) can be obtained, so the requested net cost after trade-in cannot be calculated.

Bottom line: With no eligible trade-in, the open-box S25+ (Excellent) would cost $699.99; the trade-in portion of the task is not possible.
